explanation: Store FIFO values and a decreasing deque of maximum candidates. Remove smaller candidates when enqueuing; equal maxima remain separate. Head indices avoid shifting arrays, with occasional compaction to reclaim consumed storage.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized per enqueue/dequeue and O(1) per Max.
spaceComplexity: O(n + 1) for n live entries, with bounded compaction slack.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
